newsitem.title: UK: Ldn freight-Baltic Index just higher, futures ease.
newsitem.headline: Ldn freight-Baltic Index just higher, futures ease.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose two points on Tuesday to 1,467 points while the twice weekly Handy-index rose 23 points to 1,039.
Brokers said Panamaxes remained steady with prospects that a late crop in Latin America could buoy demand for both Panamaxes and Handies by March or April.
However, one broker said the physical market was at present steady to softer.
This was reflected in some light selling on Biffex futures that took most-traded March down 20 to 1540 points in volume of 89 lots.
Some market participants did not think that the levels for physical fixings lately had justified the recent run-up in paper values.
Caper minerals fixtures looked likely to soften further before a recovery.
Among grains fixings reported on Tuesday, brokers said EMC's recent 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan for March 7/21 was fixed at $25.85 with no combination. This was amended from $25.75.
Elsewhere Jewel I 65,402 dwt was taken by Panocean delivery Santos March for 3/5 months at $12,350 daily plus $250,000 bonus.

ADM fixed 23,500 meals USGulf to Ireland Feb 15/23 at $15.75 while Elikon 28,234 dwt was recently taken by Canadian Forest delivery UK/Cont Feb 15/20 for 6/8 months $6,250 daily up to mid April thereafter $7,250 daily, brokers said.
In coal fixtures, Creciente fixed 140,000/10 Richards Bay/ Rotterdam March 22/April 7 at $7.25 to Pand O.
